status_summary: Executive Order 14191 (signed 2025-01-29) directed Interior to plan mechanisms letting families of BIE-eligible students use federal funds for other schooling options and to report on BIE school performance. A BIE draft implementation plan dated 2025-06-30, put to tribal consultation on 2025-07-14 and 2025-07-15, relies on an Education Department fund set-aside of about 1.3 million dollars, tribal control conversions, tribal education departments and added student services; a 2025-06-25 news report says the plan stopped short of funding private or charter options after tribal objections. No final plan and no Land Buy-Back reauthorization were found.

timeline.event: Executive Order 14191 signed, with a section directing Interior to plan school-choice mechanisms for BIE-eligible students.
BIE circulated a draft EO 14191 implementation plan for tribal consultation sessions on 2025-07-14 and 2025-07-15.

title: Overhaul Bureau of Indian Education schools around parents and student data
uncertainties: Whether the draft plan was finalized or put into effect after July 2025 was not found. An AP report of July 2026 describes improved BIE graduation data and a November 2025 handoff of some Education Department Native programs to BIE; it is background, not a timeline event. A news search found no Land Buy-Back reauthorization bill.
